title: Front page Executive lead carries an 'as of' two days old (09:43 UTC on 27 October; the claim's stamp is 07:14 UTC on 29 October)
note: Desk's 10:40 read of 29 October, edition 0.22.53. Same fault as desk-0003: one statement, three as-of times (09:43 27 Oct, 00:09 29 Oct, 07:14 29 Oct). Message sent to the correspondent. 17:40 re-read: the correspondent re-stamped the readers' lines (to 14:47 UTC) but the built front page still says 'As of 09:43 UTC on 27 October' in the Executive lead and 'latest evidence 00:09 UTC' in the header: the page is edition 0.22.53 (07:04 UTC), so the lead needs the next edition, not another re-stamp. Waits on dev's edition (or the editor's call on a signed log, dev's proposal of 29 October). 30 October 10:40 correction: edition 0.22.54 is live and the lead still says 'As of 09:43 UTC on 27 October', so it is not edition lag: the text is in data files/sections.json (briefing and section texts) and files/personas.json, which the readers'-lines re-stamp does not reach. Owner is the journalist or story-site (whoever keeps sections.json); message sent to the journalist and the correspondent. The desk has not edited the files.
